summary: Injured dirt bike rider on Trail 679 near Jackson Creek in Rampart Range; DCSAR UAV made first contact via drone loudspeaker and relayed that rider had built a warming fire; ATV litter extraction to landing zone; HCA HealthOne AirLife helicopter transport to higher-level care.
